story.titleZh: 勒克莱尔无视两次进站指令，阻挡汉密尔顿
story.summaryZh: 法拉利车队在同一圈内两次要求查尔斯·勒克莱尔进站，但他选择不进站，导致刘易斯·汉密尔顿被阻挡的时间比车队预期的更长。
story.originalTitle: Leclerc failed to obey two orders to pit while he held Hamilton up
story.summaryEn: Ferrari asked Charles Leclerc to pit twice on the same lap, but he chose not to, causing Lewis Hamilton to be held up longer than the team expected.
detailZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔在荷兰大奖赛上阻挡队友时，毫不怀疑法拉利希望他进站。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在比赛中和赛后抱怨车队行动太慢，未能确保勒克莱尔在第40圈左右两人相遇时不阻挡他。然而勒克莱尔在同一圈内两次被告知进站，却未能执行。
车队原本希望在第41圈让勒克莱尔进站，但不想让他跟随乔治·拉塞尔的梅赛德斯进入维修区。法拉利告诉车手“反向”于拉塞尔进站，因此当梅赛德斯进站时，勒克莱尔遵循车队指令，也没有进站。
与此同时，汉密尔顿正在接近勒克莱尔，并担心队友会阻挡他。第42圈初，法拉利告诉勒克莱尔进站。
然而勒克莱尔对指令提出异议，告诉法拉利这会让他在拉塞尔面前处于劣势，后者已提前进站。经过一段沉默，时间足够勒克莱尔催促比赛工程师布莱恩·博齐回复，法拉利第二次指示车手进站。但勒克莱尔没有进站。
汉密尔顿越来越愤怒，告诉车队“我们只是在浪费时间。”在勒克莱尔最终在下一圈进站后，汉密尔顿讽刺地评论道：“太浪费时间了，伙计们，干得好。”
法拉利车手在拉塞尔之后完赛，汉密尔顿第四，领先勒克莱尔。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔赛后声称，车队愿意接受汉密尔顿在比赛这个阶段损失一些时间，因为他们试图在不再次更换轮胎的情况下到达终点。
“关于刘易斯的情况是，我们一度试图坚持到终点，我认为那也会是个好决定，”他告诉天空体育。“我们可能和查尔斯损失了一秒。当你要坚持到终点时，目标不是这个，当然，考虑到之后发生的事情，你总是可以重新改写比赛。”
“反向于拉塞尔进站，反向于拉塞尔进站。”
“你什么意思？那会毁了我的比赛，我在拉塞尔之后两圈进站。”
勒克莱尔经过维修区入口但没有进站
“所以进站，查尔斯，进站，将换硬胎，加两格。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc was in no doubt Ferrari wanted him to pit when he was holding his team mate up during the Dutch Grand Prix.

Lewis Hamilton complained during and after the race that the team acted too slowly to ensure Leclerc did not hold him up when the pair met on-track around lap 40. However Leclerc was told twice on the same lap to come in and failed to.

The team originally hoped to bring Leclerc in on lap 41 but did not want him to follow George Russell’s Mercedes into the pit lane. Ferrari told their driver to pit “opposite” Russell, so when the Mercedes came in Leclerc followed his team’s order and did not pit as well.
Meanwhile Hamilton was gaining on Leclerc and becoming concerned his team mate would hold him up. Early on lap 42 Ferrari told Leclerc to come in.

However Leclerc disputed the order, telling Ferrari it would put him at a disadvantage to Russell, who had pitted earlier. After a period of silence, which was long enough for Leclerc to prompt his race engineer Bryan Bozzi for a reply, Ferrari gave the driver a second instruction to pit. But Leclerc did not come in.

Hamilton was becoming increasingly infuriated, telling the team “we’re just losing time.” After Leclerc finally pitted on the next lap, following another instruction from Ferrari, Hamilton sarcastically commented: “Big waste of time guys, good job.”
The Ferrari drivers finished the race behind Russell, with Hamilton fourth ahead of Leclerc.

Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur claimed after the race the team was willing to accept Hamilton losing some time at this stage in the race as they were attempting to reach the chequered flag without changing his tyres again.

“The story with Lewis was that at one stage we were trying to go to the end and I think it would have been a good call, also,” he told Sky. “Probably we lost one second with Charles. The target when you go to the end, it’s not this one, and for sure with what’s happened after, you can always rewrite the race.”
Box opposite Russell, box opposite Russell.
What do you mean? That fucks my race, I stop two laps after Russell.
Leclerc passes the pit lane entrance without coming in
So box, Charles, box, will be for hard, plus two clicks.
keyPointsZh: 车队最初希望勒克莱尔在第41圈进站，但不想让他跟随乔治·拉塞尔的梅赛德斯进入维修区，因此指示他“反向”于拉塞尔进站。
勒克莱尔对进站指令提出异议，认为这会让他在拉塞尔面前处于劣势，随后车队第二次发出进站指令，但他仍未进站。
汉密尔顿对延误感到愤怒，在勒克莱尔最终进站后讽刺道：“太浪费时间了，伙计们，干得好。”
keyPointsEn: The team originally hoped to bring Leclerc in on lap 41 but did not want him to follow George Russell's Mercedes into the pit lane, so instructed him to pit 'opposite' Russell.
Leclerc disputed the order, saying it would put him at a disadvantage to Russell, and after a second instruction to pit, he still did not come in.
Hamilton was infuriated by the delay and sarcastically commented after Leclerc finally pitted: 'Big waste of time guys, good job.'

relatedItems.originalTitle: Hamilton set for Brazil grid penalty after Ferrari's worst 2026 Friday
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿将在本周末的巴西大奖赛中被处以发车位罚分，这是法拉利2026年迄今为止最糟糕的一个周五。
汉密尔顿在FP2练习中是速度较快的法拉利车手，但比基米·安东内利的基准成绩慢了0.450秒，队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔落后近三十分之一，这种差距主要是由起终点直道上的部署问题造成的。
法拉利的长距离速度看起来也稳固地排在第四位，勒克莱尔在相同轮胎上的长距离每圈比安东内利慢半秒。
法拉利在预期的弱点上表现不佳——从Juncao到计时线的全油门长距离行驶——汉密尔顿（红色线条）在这一部分仅对安东内利（蓝色线条）落后三十分之一。
汉密尔顿在到达4号弯左转前的第二个直道上比安东内利慢了11公里每小时，在那里失去了超过十分之半的时间。
但法拉利在弯道上的通常优势在巴西也并不完全存在，正如勒克莱尔在FP2之后确认的那样，他说‘在弯道上的车感觉可能是本赛季最糟糕的周五感觉之一’。
车队老板弗雷德·瓦瑟尔承认，‘在平衡方面还有很多工作要做’。
《赛车》杂志了解到，汉密尔顿将面临一场发车线处罚，因为法拉利计划在FP2之后更换发动机部件。
汉密尔顿从五位发车位起跑，凭借在冲刺赛中从第20位冲到第5位，最终在2021年巴西大奖赛中从第10位发车位逆袭夺冠，这成为了他著名的逆转故事。
乔治·拉塞尔已经确认将面临五位发车位罚退。
队友勒克莱尔可能在下一轮拉斯维加斯的比赛中因为引擎部件更换而受到发车位罚退。
法拉利需要在巴西避免被梅赛德斯以三分之差超越，以避免在本周末的 构造商锦标赛中被锁定。
那是在周五之后看起来有些棘手的事情，因为世界冠军基米·安东内利的梅赛德斯在短距离和长距离的比赛中都是最快的。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton is set to take a grid penalty for this weekend’s Formula 1 Brazilian Grand Prix after Ferrari’s weakest Friday of 2026 so far.

Hamilton was the faster Ferrari in FP2, but he was 0.450s slower than Kimi Antonelli’s benchmark, with team-mate Charles Leclerc almost another three tenths adrift - a deficit mostly explained by a deployment issue on the start/finish straight.
Ferrari’s long run pace looked firmly fourth-best, too, with Leclerc’s long-run over half a second per lap slower than Antonelli on the same tyre.
The Ferrari is weak where you’d expect - the long full-throttle run from Juncao to the timing line - as Hamilton (red line) ships three tenths to Antonelli (blue line) in that section alone.
Hamilton was also 11km/h slower than Antonelli on the second straight before they reach the Turn 4 left-hander, Descida de Lago, losing over a tenth and a half there.

But Ferrari’s usual prowess in corners isn’t fully present in Brazil either, as Leclerc confirmed after FP2, saying the “car in the corners just felt probably one of the worst Friday feelings of the season”.
Team boss Fred Vasseur admitted there was “a lot of work to do on the balance” overnight.
The Race understands Hamilton is set for a grid penalty as Ferrari has planned engine component changes post-FP2.
Hamilton famously bounced back from a five-place grid penalty to win the 2021 Brazilian Grand Prix from 10th on the grid, having charged from 20th to fifth in the sprint race.
George Russell already has a five-place grid penalty confirmed.
Team-mate Leclerc may get a grid penalty at the next round in Las Vegas for the engine component changes.
Ferrari needs to avoid being outscored by Mercedes by three points in Brazil to avoid the constructors' championship being sealed this weekend.
That's something that looks tricky after Friday as world champion Kimi Antonelli's Mercedes was quickest on the short and long runs.
keyPointsZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔落后近三十分之一，主要原因是起跑/终点直道上的部署问题。
keyPointsEn: Charles Leclerc was almost another three tenths adrift.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Ralf Schumacher slams Colton Herta's F1 prospects: "He's just burning fuel"
detailZh: 拉尔夫·舒马赫抨击科尔顿·赫塔的F1前景："他只是在燃烧燃料"
拉尔夫·舒马赫对科尔顿·赫塔的F1前景给出了严厉的评价，质疑了这位美国人在F2的表现，并否认了他获得凯迪拉克赛车座位的可能性
表面上，科尔顿·赫塔在Interlagos的周五似乎已经取得了难以想象的好成绩。这位凯迪拉克测试车手取代了塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯，参加了2026年圣保罗大奖赛的第一场练习，完成了24圈，并获得了他获得FIA超级执照所需的最后一点积分。从纸面上看，这位美国人现在有资格在2027年参加F1比赛。
然而，前F1车手兼评论员拉尔夫·舒马赫对此并不认同。当被问及赫塔是否可能是佩雷斯旁边的第二位凯迪拉克车手候选人时，天空德国的评论员回答说："只有当复活节和圣诞节在同一天的时候。说真的，这是没有意义的。他只是在燃烧燃料，借用弗朗茨·托斯特的一句话。我甚至不知道这有什么意义。你不如让其他人开车，给一些年轻车手一个机会。"
舒马赫特别批评了赫塔的F2赛季：“他在F2中真的很糟糕。在我看来，他根本不配。我认为他们尝试推广美国车手是很好的。但这也必须有意义，他根本不适合F1。”
与其让赫塔参赛，舒马赫更愿意看到年轻车手得到机会。他以麦克拉伦青训车队的莱昂纳多·福纳罗利为例，他在F2和F3中都赢得了冠军，称他为“一个极其出色的车手”。然而，除此之外，为佩雷斯找到合适的搭档将会“非常、非常困难”。
赫塔转战F2是为了证明自己配得上F1的席位并积累超级驾照积分。但他在锦标赛中目前排名第19，积26分，至今未能赢得一场胜利或登上领奖台。甚至F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔也承认，赫塔的表现比预期更差。
因此，赫塔通过一条替代途径获得了超级驾照。除了在印第安纳波利斯赛车赛（IndyCar）中赢得的积分，在那里他赢得了九场比赛并获得了2024年锦标赛的亚军，他还通过为凯迪拉克的周五练习赛出场获得了额外的积分。
凯迪拉克的2027赛季已经确认了一位车手：佩雷斯在10月底将合同延长至2029年。然而，瓦尔特里·博塔斯是否会继续留在车队，目前还不明确。除了赫塔之外，还有其他一些名字被提及，例如乔治·拉塞尔，他提出了梅赛德斯车手弗雷德里克·维斯蒂作为候选人。
在周五在英特拉戈斯赛道进行的练习赛中，赫塔比博塔斯慢了大约九十分之一秒。
detailEn: Ralf Schumacher slams Colton Herta's F1 prospects: "He's just burning fuel"

Ralf Schumacher has delivered a scathing assessment of Colton Herta's Formula 1 prospects, questioning the American's performances in Formula 2 and dismissing his chances of securing a Cadillac race seat

On the face of it, Friday at Interlagos could hardly have gone any better for Colton Herta. The Cadillac test driver replaced Sergio Perez in first practice for the 2026 Sao Paulo Grand Prix, completed 24 laps and secured the final point he needed for his FIA super licence. On paper, the American is now eligible to race in Formula 1 in 2027.

Former F1 driver turned pundit Ralf Schumacher, however, is having none of it. Asked whether Herta could be a candidate for the second Cadillac seat alongside Perez, the Sky Germany pundit replied: "Only if Easter and Christmas fall on the same day. Seriously, it's pointless. He's just burning fuel, to borrow a phrase from Franz Tost. I don't even know what the point of it is. You might as well put someone else in the car, give some young drivers a chance."

Schumacher was particularly critical of Herta's Formula 2 campaign: "He was really that bad in Formula 2. As far as I'm concerned, he hasn't earned it at all. I think it's great that they're trying to promote American drivers. But it has to make sense, and he has no place in Formula 1."

Instead of Herta, Schumacher would prefer to see young drivers given an opportunity. As an example, he points to McLaren junior Leonardo Fornaroli, who has won championships in both Formula 2 and Formula 3, describing him as "an incredibly strong driver". Otherwise, however, finding the right partner for Perez would be "very, very difficult".

Herta had moved to Formula 2 to prove himself worthy of a Formula 1 seat and accumulate super licence points. But he currently sits just 19th in the championship standings with 26 points, having failed to claim a victory or even a podium finish so far. Even Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel admits that Herta has struggled more than expected.

The American therefore secured his super licence through an alternative route. In addition to the points he earned in IndyCar, where he won nine races and finished runner-up in the 2024 championship, he collected further points through his Friday practice appearances for Cadillac.

One of Cadillac's 2027 seats is already confirmed: Perez extended his contract until 2029 at the end of October. Whether Valtteri Bottas will remain with the team, however, is still unclear. Several other names have been mentioned alongside Herta, with George Russell, for example, putting Mercedes talent Frederik Vesti forward as a candidate.
In their head-to-head comparison during Friday's practice session at Interlagos, Herta was around nine tenths of a second slower than Bottas.
keyPointsZh: 赫塔现在符合2027年F1参赛资格。
keyPointsEn: Colton Herta is now eligible to race in Formula 1 in 2027.
